title: Modular inverse by exponentiation
statement: Let $p$ be prime and let $a$ be a natural number whose residue modulo $p$ is nonzero. The residue modulo $p$ of the remainder of $a^{p-2}$ upon division by $p$ equals the multiplicative inverse of the residue of $a$.
